topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: The air holds the sharp scent of sap and freshly cut wood, a stark contrast to the sweet, familiar essence that once stood here, tall and unyielding. My paws press into the soft earth where the roots once ran deep, where the shadows played and danced with the light. Now, the ground is disturbed, chunks of bark and splinters litter the space. I circle the area, faster, the rhythm of my breathing quickening. The quiet now, it screams louder than any gust through the leaves ever did. My fur bristles, each strand standing on end as I search, but there is only this gaping hole where something vital used to be.
